description: Überschwemmungsgebiete nach NWG (Landkreis Hildesheim) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Areas of the current fixed and provisionally secured floodplains in the district of Hildesheim. The floodplains are defined as the areas in which a flood event is to be expected statistically once in 100 years. Floodplains are defined by the Lower Water Authority by regulation. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains according to NWG (District of Hildesheim)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Überschwemmung, inspireidentifiziert, Festgesetzte Überschwemmungsgebiete, Hochwasserschutz. The listing shows 2019-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
